correctness.rationale: The exact 2m-cell transition matrix yields the normalized invariant density; every m-step smooth branch has slope at least m, and the finite Markov graph is primitive, giving a unique acim. A full-branch central return gives iid uniform waits; conditioning on uniform excursion starts yields q_m(n)=2(1-1/m)^n-1 for n<=m. Stationary residual life gives the finite sum and exact C_m formula. Finite differences identify the minimum and the exceptional m=2 tie. Uniform exponent convergence gives the macroscopic negative limit. Independent rational Markov calculation verifies 493 m,n values, not relied on as proof of the infinite quantifier.

value.rationale: Exact sign autocorrelation is a natural structural observable of a PWL map motivated as a random-output generator. The proof demonstrates a measurable long-memory effect at a physically meaningful neutral outer-slope boundary: one-step switching probability tends to zero, yet a universal negative time-correlation trough survives at a lag proportional to the inner slope. The model-specific stationary density, all-lags-up-to-m law and sharp extremum go substantively beyond numerical histograms, fixed-point checks, or elementary parameter substitution. No claims of cryptographic security are inferred.
